authority: Owned-process replay against the installed original MVD Image Calibration SDK; no devices or platform initialization
sourceLifecycle: The probe creates an IImageCalibTool inside each board/model/warp iteration and destroys it before the next iteration.
confirmed: Within this controlled SDK probe, a newly created tool instance can receive the same native workspace address as the previous instance.
The n-dependent median-sort prefix at that address begins zero in the first case and contains prior nonzero data in later cases.
The undefined prefix therefore depends on SDK-process allocation reuse in this probe; a per-tool-instance state object alone does not model it.
unknown: Whether the VisionMaster production host uses the same allocator, arena, or workspace lifetime.
Whether any production initialization or intervening calls clear or overwrite this prefix before fitting.
A portable deterministic default for the original uninitialized bytes.
scope: This evidence narrows the lifecycle boundary for captured SDK fixtures; it does not establish production-host parity or justify hardcoding the captured prefix.
